openIssues.text: No ambient occlusion or contact shadow. Small props read as pasted on when they stand inside a cast shadow. This is half of defect 3 and it needs an AO pass in Tier 1.
Depth of field is not implemented. It needs a DepthTexture, which cannot share the 4x MSAA scene target; add a resolved depth prepass in Tier 1. Do not bolt DOF onto the current target.
Ground detail normal map repeats visibly at its ~22 m tile from the top shot. Needs a second octave at a different repeat, or triplanar variation.
The placeholder heightfield reads as sand dunes: ridged noise plus a bright sandy palette. It is scaffolding, not a look decision, and the world lane replaces it.
Night lighting was tuned to a readable linear median of 0.03 but has had no art pass. Tier 1 owns it.
FRAME_HEIGHT_M = 18 (the deferred orthographic scale) is set from a pixel-height argument, not from playtesting a party of three plus enemies. Revisit once traversal lands.

openIssues.title: Exposure is fixed at 1.05 and only ever tuned at dawn. Every other hour blows out.
openIssues.cause: Not key intensity — KEY_RAMP is nearly flat (6.4 to 7.4 to 6.1). It is cos-law on the ground plus the sky IBL ramp. Ground receives key*sin(elevation): sin(11.6deg)=0.20 vs sin(61.3deg)=0.88, times the sky ramp 3.9 to 4.8. Product ~8.5x, which matches the measured median ratio.
openIssues.fix: postfx.js line ~217 deliberately chose fixed exposure so an art-directed hour cannot drift. Keep that. Make exposure a RAMP over sun elevation in the same idiom as SKY_RAMP and KEY_RAMP, not auto-exposure.
openIssues.status: FIXED 2026-09-03 by cfd-world as a scoped spot-fix. Verified on the wide shot at 6.4, 9.9, 12, 18.5 and 21.5 h.
openIssues.pullReason: Phase 2's gate scores the character look at three times of day. Two of the three are 6-7x over band, so the Character Look Gate would fail the rig for a render bug. Cheaper now than after Phase 2 burns a round.

fixApplied.how: EXPOSURE_RAMP, a table of exposure against sun elevation, read with rampValue() (rampLookup's scalar sibling) and written to engine.post.params.exposure from Environment.setTime(). Still fixed per hour: no metering, no auto-exposure, deterministic. postfx.js keeps 1.05 as the dawn seed for the frame before the first setTime, and a manual __DAWN__.post({exposure}) still overrides until the next time change.
fixApplied.anchor: The [8] and [12] entries put 11.55 deg (DAWN_HOUR 6.4) at exposure 1.0503, so the signed-off dawn frame is unchanged. Below -6 deg the ramp flattens to the same 1.05 the night was tuned at, so the moonlit look is untouched.

6.4h (11.6deg).verdict: in band, unchanged from the signed-off frame

21.5h (-17.8deg).verdict: unchanged by design; the dawn band does not apply to night, MOON_RAMP was tuned to median ~0.03

verified.sweep: Every hour from 5.6 to 18.5 lands 0.116-0.222 on wide. All seven review shots probed at all five hours: worst blown-white 0.03% at 9.9h and 12h, excluding the `sun` shot which points into the disc.

residualNotOwnedByThisFix: 18.7-19.3 h reads median 0.25-0.31 on wide (0.22-0.26 on top), just over the band ceiling. Cause measured, not guessed: at the SAME sun elevation the evening ground is 1.3-1.4x brighter than the morning ground even on the `top` shot with no sky in frame, because the dune slopes in the probe region face the setting azimuth (264 deg) more squarely than the rising one (96 deg). An elevation-keyed ramp cannot see that and should not: exposure follows the sun, not the terrain. Fixing it would need auto-exposure, which is explicitly rejected. white% stays at 0.01, so it is bright, not blown.

The dusk cliff at the horizon crossing is untouched and pre-existing: wide median 0.136 at 19.75h (elev +0.7) falls to 0.021 at 19.9h (elev -1.1) and 0.010 at 20.1h with 8.2% black. That is KEY_RAMP [0, 3.60] -> [-4, 0.55] plus the sun disc leaving the sky, not exposure. Separate issue for whoever owns the twilight ramp.

Noon reads correctly exposed in the near field but milky in the far field on wide. The cause is the distance fog at high sun: horizonColor lerps to the pale blue 0x9db9dd as `warm` goes to 0, at density 0.0011. Grade knobs (contrast 1.06, saturation 1.10, split 0.85) are also dawn-tuned. Both are outside this spot-fix.
